category.quote: ₹ 20000/ - will be given as a lump sum assistance to such surviving member of the household of the deceased poor, who after local inquiry, is found to be the head of the household.

gate_notes: Family must be living Below Poverty Line (BPL)
Primary breadwinner must be deceased; deceased's age was more than 18 years and less than 60 years
Applicant must be the succeeding primary breadwinner / head of household found after local inquiry
